shard.name: ARK: Survival Evolved
shard.description: ARK: Survival Evolved dedicated Linux server with customizable maps, player limits, and full mod support.
shard.author: Studio Wildcard & Midnight Team
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# ARK: Survival Evolved Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apt update && apt install -y curl lib32gcc-s1 ca-certificates

cd /tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/steamcmd
cd /tmp/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz "https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz"
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz

echo "Installing ARK: Survival Evolved (App ID 376030)..."
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update 376030 validate +quit

cd /mnt/server
chmod +x ShooterGame/Binaries/Linux/ShooterGameServer
echo "ARK installation completed!"
